Property.name: SuccessEmailSubject
Property.Description: This is the subject to use on the success email

Property.name: SucessEmailBody
Property.Description: This is the body that will be included in the success email

Property.name: FailureEmailSubject
Property.Description: This is the subject to use on the failure email

Property.name: FailureEmailBody
Property.Description: This is the body that will be included in the failure email

Property.name: valueToBeReplaced
Property.Description: Property to store the values to be replaced

Method.name: OnMessage
replaceWithParticularFormat
Method.Implementation: Set key = "" For { Set ReplaceVal = ..valueToBeReplaced.GetNext(.key) Set SubBody = $REPLACE(SubBody,key,ReplaceVal) Quit:key="" } $$$TRACE("Done with replacement") Quit SubBody
